CustomField.description: Structured eligibility filter for the parent record, enforced both in the picker and server-side. One condition per line: FieldApiName:Operator:Value. Operators are =, !=, or IN. Lines combine with AND.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter one condition per line as FieldApiName:Operator:Value. Operators are =, !=, and IN (comma-separated values). Example: Industry:=:Technology
CustomField.label: Context Filter Criteria
